demos.title: ASCII Roguelike
demos.model: Qwen3.6 27B, running locally in LM Studio
demos.prompt: Build a turn-based ASCII roguelike as a single HTML page in vanilla JavaScript — no libraries. Procedurally generate dungeons with connected rooms and corridors across at least 5 descending levels. Include field-of-view with fog of war (explored-but-unseen areas dimmed), monsters with simple chase AI that take turns when you move, melee combat with HP/attack/defense, healing potions and weapon pickups, an inventory, a message log, stairs down, a final goal item, and permadeath with a run summary. Render in a monospace grid with colour.

suggestions.label: Archer enemy
suggestions.text: Add a ranged enemy: an archer that shoots arrows at the player when it can see them, and keeps its distance.

suggestions.label: Floor colour themes
suggestions.text: Give each dungeon floor its own colour theme for walls, floors and the fog of war.

suggestions.label: Mini-map
suggestions.text: Add a mini-map of the explored dungeon in the corner of the sidebar.

suggestions.label: Stacking potions
suggestions.text: Make potions stack in the inventory and show a count beside each item.
